hook: Miami Beach, upside down, from inside an F-22.
narration: This is Miami Beach, upside down, from inside an F-22 Raptor.
The pilot is Captain Nick Le Tourneau, commander of the F-22 Raptor demonstration team.
In May two thousand twenty five, his team flew at the air and sea show in Miami.
Every hard turn pressed him into his seat with several times his own body weight.
His flight suit has air bladders that squeeze his legs and stomach in those turns, so blood stays in his head and he stays awake.
A camera in the cockpit rode the whole show, the ocean and the skyline wheeling past the canopy.
outcome: Le Tourneau flew the full Raptor demonstration over Miami Beach with the camera rolling.
title: Miami Beach upside down from an F-22
description:
Capt. Nick Le Tourneau, commander of the F-22 Raptor Aerial Demonstration Team, flies a full-length demonstration over Miami Beach, Florida, on May 24, 2025, filmed from the cockpit.
